title: Voxel Data
description: Enhance your gameplay experience with new item and block tags.
body:
![Voxel Data Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f577de907630035d1250a89de3ed96debd230b1.png)

> [Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/QDSYsQzrj2) to report bugs, suggest mods or features, or to simply chat.

Enhance your gameplay with new item and block tags! The mod does not provide any preset entries. You will need to create a datapack or use mods to add entries to the tags.

# 💰 Content
Currently adds the following tags:

```
blocks/repels_arachnids - Defined blocks repel (cave) spiders.
blocks/repels_creepers - Defined blocks repel creepers.
blocks/repels_undead - Defined blocks repel undead mobs like zombies, skeletons, etc.
blocks/turtle_eggs_placeable_on - Allows turtles to place their eggs on the defined blocks.

items/allow_walk_on_powder_snow - Allows walking on powder snow while wearing the defined items.
items/distracts_endermen - Allows you to stare into the souls of endermen without consequence while wearing the defined items.
items/distracts_piglins - Makes piglins neutral towards you while wearing the defined items.
items/prevents_pricking - Prevents cactus & berry bush damage while wearing the defined items.
items/repels_arachnids - Defined items repel (cave) spiders when worn or held.
items/repels_creepers - Defined items repel creepers when worn or held.
items/repels_undead -  Defined items repel undead mobs when worn or held.

trim_material/distracts_endermen_trim - Allows you to stare into the souls of endermen without consequence while wearing the defined trim material(s).
trim_material/distracts_piglins_trim - Makes piglins neutral towards you while wearing the defined trim material(s).
trim_material/repels_arachnids_trim - Defined items repel (cave) spiders when worn.
trim_material/repels_creepers_trim - Defined items repel creepers when worn.
trim_material/repels_undead_trim - Defined items repel undead mobs when worn or held.
```
